subject: Mind Ring
text: A chest in the basement area outside the walls of Forfeit contains the Mind Ring.

evidence.quote: From the entrance, walk around the outside of the walls to the steps to the basement area. Go down to the stairs to find a chest which contains the MIND RING (INT+30, MGR+10, sell).

subject: Hi Potion
text: Bookshelves in the upper left room of Forfeit contain a Hi Potion and Hi Magic.

evidence.quote: In the upper left room, examine the bookshelves which contain a HI POTION and HI MAGIC.

subject: Black Market
text: The shop to the left on the second floor of Forfeit sells everything you have sold in the game.

evidence.quote: The shop to the left sells everything that you have sold in the game, so if you want something back, you can get it.

subject: Ribbon
text: Bookshelves in the second-floor shop of Forfeit contain a Ribbon and Gown.

evidence.quote: However, this will also give you access to the bookshelves which contain a RIBBON and GOWN.

subject: Tower of Light
text: Advancing the plot at the next town before visiting the Tower of Light will cause you to permanently miss one of the best pieces of equipment in the game.

evidence.quote: At this point, that's every town in the world that we can access except the one that will advance the plot. However, you don't want to go there yet, because if you do, you will lose out on one of the best pieces of equipment in the game. Instead, we're going to sequence break by going to the next dungeon first.

subject: Tower of Light
text: Mad Lillies and Trap Harps have high HP, so Jerin should cast Flame against groups of them.

evidence.quote: Mad Lillies and Trap Harps have a ton of HP, so make sure to have Jerin cast Flame against groups of them.

subject: Basement Chests
text: Dropping into the pitfall to the basement reveals six chests containing a Hi Bomb, two Ex Potions, a Stone Cure, a Power Potion, and a Spell Potion.

evidence.quote: Walk straight up into the pitfall to the basement, where you will find six chests which contain a HI BOMB, 2 EX POTION, STONE CURE, POWER POTION, SPELL POTION.

subject: Undead Ring
text: Falling through a pitfall in the lower left dead-end leads to a chest containing the Undead Ring.

evidence.quote: Enter the lower left room and climb to sets of stairs to a dead-end. Walk around until you find a pitfall leading to a chest which contains the UNDEAD RING (sell).

subject: Sea Ring
text: Falling through a pitfall reached from the lower right room leads to a chest containing the Sea Ring.

evidence.quote: This time, enter the lower right room and climb two sets of stairs to a dead-end. Walk around until you find a pitfall leading to a chest which contains the SEA RING (sell).

subject: Stone Cure
text: A chest in the lower room of the second floor contains a Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: Go down to the room on the lower end of the floor and enter to find a chest which contains a STONE CURE.

subject: Revive
text: A chest on the third floor contains a Revive.

evidence.quote: Head down to a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: Ex Magic and Ex Potion
text: Sidestepping the pitfall in the right room of the third floor leads to two chests containing an Ex Magic and an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Instead, sidestep it one to the left, then up to the two chests which contain an EX MAGIC and EX POTION.

subject: Revive
text: A chest in the tiny room near the third floor stairs contains a Revive.

evidence.quote: Go back to the stairs, then up to the tiny room with a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: Ex Potion
text: Taking the left path at the fork on the fourth floor leads to a chest containing an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Head right up to a fork, where you should take the left path to a chest which contains a EX POTION.

subject: Miracle
text: Opening the chest from the left in the room past the fork yields a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Follow the straight-forward path until you find a room with a chest. Open it from the left to find a MIRACLE.

subject: Gloom Voice
text: Opening the chest near the stairs from the upper side gives a Gloom Voice.

evidence.quote: From the upper side of it, open the nearby chest which contains a GLOOM VOICE.

subject: Might Helmet
text: A chest on the roof of the Tower of Light contains the missable Might Helmet.

evidence.quote: At the top of this floor are the stairs which eventually lead to the roof, where you will find a chest which contains the MIGHT HELMET (DFP+35, INT+25, MGR+19, equip on Jerin). This is the only one in the game. If you want until later to come here, you can never get it.

subject: Power Gourd
text: Opening the chest from the left in the lower right room three floors down contains a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Climb the stairs and from the left, open the chest which contains a POWER GOURD.

subject: Tower of Light Pitfall Room
text: Falling through the hidden pitfall leads to four chests containing a Great Axe, Large Shield, Plate Cap, and Silver Robe.

evidence.quote: Walk around until you find another hidden pitfall to the four chests which contain the GREAT AXE (equip on Hero), LARGE SHIELD, PLATE CAP, and SILVER ROBE (equip on Jerin).

subject: Escape
text: The Escape spell does not work inside towers, except while on the roof.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, you will have to walk out of the tower, as Escape does not work in towers, except on the roof.

subject: Bakku House Bookshelves
text: The bookshelves in the house above the entrance of Bakku contain an Ex Potion, Ex Magic, and Revive.

evidence.quote: In the house above you, examine all the bookshelves which contain an EX POTION, EX MAGIC, and REVIVE.

subject: Cooper
text: Cooper is rescued in the final room across the swamp on the 5th Level of the Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Walk right, into the room, all the way to the right, down into the room, and across the swamp into the final room, where you will find Cooper.

subject: Raile
text: Raile instructs you to collect 7 pieces of Alumina.

evidence.quote: Head down to the basement and talk to Raile. He will tell you to find 7 pieces of Alumina.

subject: Hydra
text: Hydras can drop Might Swords, and Mega Frogs can drop Miracles.

evidence.quote: Hydras can drop Might Swords, and Mega Frogs can drop Miracles.

subject: Mega Frog
text: Mega Frogs can cast Champion to fully restore HP, which Lufia can halt by casting Deflect.

evidence.quote: Watch out for Mega Frogs, as they can cast Champion to fully restore their HP. Have Lufia cast Deflect against them to put a stop to that.

subject: Sweet Water
text: Walking right on the 7th level leads to two chests, one containing a Sweet Water and one empty.

evidence.quote: Walk right to two chests which contain a SWEET WATER and is empty.

subject: Gloom Pick
text: Continuing right through the swamp leads to two chests containing a Gloom Pick and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Cast Float and continue right through the swamp to two chests which contain a GLOOM PICK and is empty.

subject: Ex Potion
text: Two chests on the right wall contain an Ex Potion and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: On the right wall are two more chests which contain an EX POTION and is empty.

subject: Gloom Voice
text: Searching the upper right corner of the swamp in the room reveals a hidden Gloom Voice.

evidence.quote: Enter the room, cast Float, and search the upper right corner of the swamp to find a hidden GLOOM VOICE.

subject: Upper Path Chests
text: Taking the upper path past the stairs leads to three chests containing an Ex Magic, a Power Potion, and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: First, take the upper path to three chests which contain an EX MAGIC, POWER POTION, and is empty.

subject: Spell Potion
text: Two chests in the upper left corner by the stairs contain a Spell Potion and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: In the upper left corner by the stairs are two chests which contain a SPELL POTION and is empty.

subject: Buster Sword
text: Climbing the stairs reveals two chests containing a Buster Sword and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Climb the stairs to find two chests which contain a BUSTER SWORD (equip on Hero) and is empty.

subject: Crown Jewels
text: The back room holds four chests containing the Crown Jewels, 2 Miracles, and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Enter the back room with four chests which contain the CROWN JEWELS, 2 MIRACLES, and is empty.

subject: Hi Magic
text: Taking the lower path leads to two chests containing a Hi Magic and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Head back down the steps, this time taking the lower path to two chests which contain a HI MAGIC and is empty.

subject: Ex Potion and Float
text: A ladder leads to three chests containing an Ex Potion, Float, and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Climb the stairs back to the main area and climb the nearby ladder to three chests which contain an EX POTION, FLOAT, and is empty.

subject: Great Potion
text: Heading right into the wide open area leads to a chest containing a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: Go right to a chest which contains a GREAT POTION.

subject: Open Area Lower Path
text: The right path down in the wide area contains three chests containing a Spell Potion, a Power Potion, and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: First, take the right path down to three chests which contain a SPELL POTION, POWER POTION, and is empty.

subject: Ex Magic
text: Climbing down the ladder to the right leads to two chests containing an Ex Magic and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Climb down the ladder to the right and around to two chests which contain an EX MAGIC and is empty.

subject: Miracle
text: Crossing the swamp to the left with Float leads to a chest containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Use the Float and cross the swamp to the left to a chest which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: Basement Ex Potion
text: Two chests near the basement stairs contain an Ex Potion and an empty chest.

evidence.quote: Open the two nearby chests which contain an EX POTION and is empty.

subject: Wind Flute
text: A chest in the room above the fork contains the Wind Flute, which restores about 50 HP to everyone infinitely.

evidence.quote: Enter the room above to find a chest which contains the WIND FLUTE, a very useful item that restores about 50 HP to everyone can be used infinitely for free.

subject: Clear Silk
text: Heading toward the upper right corner from the fork leads to a chest containing Clear Silk.

evidence.quote: Go back to the fork and head towards the upper right corner to a chest which contains a CLEAR SILK (equip on Jerin).

subject: Miracle
text: Climbing the ladder near the upper right corner leads to a chest containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Climb the ladder to a chest which contains a MIRACLE, then walk left to the stairs back to the main area.

subject: Mind Potion
text: Climbing down the ladder back in the main area leads to a chest containing a Mind Potion.

evidence.quote: Climb down the ladder to another chest which contains a MIND POTION.

subject: Escape
text: Walking left leads to the final three chests containing an Escape and two empty chests.

evidence.quote: Finally, walk left to pick up the last three chests which contain an ESCAPE and the rest are empty.

subject: Crown Jewels
text: Exchanging the Crown Jewels in Grenoble grants a reward of 10000 Gold.

evidence.quote: Return to Grenoble to exchange the Crown Jewels to receive your reward of 10000 GOLD.

subject: Might Helmet
text: If you did not collect the Might Helmet on your earlier visit to the Tower of Light, it is permanently missed.

evidence.quote: If you haven't already been here before, you missed out on a Might Helmet.

subject: Tower of Light Revisited
text: Equip Lufia temporarily with her Flash Ring before speaking to the man on the roof of the Tower of Light.

evidence.quote: Temporarily equip Lufia with her Flash Ring and talk to the man you're looking for.
